verdict.rationale: Orama ships an open-source search library that you embed and run in your own application, including browser and Deno. Orama Cloud also offers on-premise deployment of its context server on your own infrastructure, and the docs describe API parity for migrating between Cloud and Open Source. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, a documented self-hosting/on-prem deployment guide (on-prem appears to be a vendor-run engagement), and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.
